official_authorities.label: Geneva Enterprises, Inc. v. Hashimi (Virginia Court of Appeals)

calculation.reason: Historical rates and all statutory calculation branches have not yet been fully modeled.

annual_rate.notes: Chapter 646 of the 2004 Virginia Acts reduced the general judgment rate from 9% to 6%, effective July 1, 2004. Va. Code §§6.2-302 and 8.01-382 govern rate selection and accrual; a contract judgment uses the lawfully charged contract rate or 6%, whichever is higher, and the selected rate stays fixed after entry. The sources reviewed do not establish one universal calculator-grade day count, compounding, payment-allocation, or special-judgment method. Verify applicability; not legal advice.
